verdict: Organic channels are carrying all activity; no paid campaigns are running.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every engagement came entirely from organic sources — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for the full 28 days. Combined, your Google Business Profile listings drove 401 total actions (23 calls, 257 direction requests, and 121 website clicks), which shows meaningful local search presence without any paid support behind it. O'Hare Precision's organic search clicks dipped 18% week-over-week and three consecutive days of near-zero GBP activity across locations suggest a short-term softening worth watching. We are monitoring the organic search signals closely and reviewing whether GBP data from the last three days reflects a reporting lag or a genuine dip before any action is taken.
